title: [Chapitre] IX et IX bis. [Ateliers] : notes manuscrites (05-15/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, inferred from this page and its neighbours. I = [ω0, ω1] is a compact interval and M is a space stratified into 0-dimensional strata (the stratum set M_0, points) and 1-dimensional strata (the stratum set M_1, open intervals). There is a specialization or incidence order on strata (written <<° and ◁, with s ◁ X meaning 'the point stratum s lies in the boundary of the interval stratum X'). Constructible parts of M are unions of strata. Grothendieck works with 'polygons' Φ (sets of strata), a duality Φ ↦ Φ*, the operation Omb° ('ombre', shadow), and supp°/cosupp°.

Top of page. From Σ = Cons^b(Φ) he recovers a decomposition:
- Φ_1 = the maximal elements of Σ (for <<°) that are 1-strata;
- Φ_is = the maximal elements of Σ that are 0-strata, i.e. isolated points;
- the remaining point strata, Φ_0 \ Φ_is = (∪_{X∈Φ_1} ∂X) ∩ Σ = { s ∈ Σ ∩ M_0 | ∃X ∈ Φ_1 with s ◁ X }, i.e. the endpoints of the chosen intervals.
This is the inverse step of the bijection Purif(M) → Cons(M), Φ ↦ Omb°(Φ), stated on the previous page.

Middle of page. Consequences stated:
- The complement of a constructible part is constructible.
- Passing to the complement corresponds, via the sides of polygons, to passing to the complementary polygon.

Formalization. A découpage T ∈ Dcp(I) (written Dr_p(I) in the machine transcription) is a finite subset T ⊃ ∂I, ordered t_0 = ω0 < t_1 < … < t_n = ω1, with n its length. Its interval strata are {t_0}, I_{t_0t_1}, {t_1}, …, I_{t_{n-1}t_n}, {t_n}; call this set Φ_T. A polygon subordinate to T is any subset Φ ⊂ Φ_T, and CΦ denotes its complement in Φ_T.

Next page. He proves (CΦ)** = Φ* and cosupp°Φ = supp°(CΦ). From these he gets a map D(Φ_T) → Σ_cons(M), Φ ↦ S_Φ, which commutes with complement and hence with intersections. He presents this as verifying a 'supports axiom' Atsupp 1.

Purpose. This is a toy model, a stratified interval, for an axiomatics of supports and cosupports with a duality exchanging 'isolated' and 'local' boundary behaviour. It belongs to the 1986 'Ateliers' chapter, plausibly part of the reflection on supports and constructibility around derivators and tame topology.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The page is a fragmentary draft with several struck-out attempts, e.g. the abandoned definition Φ_0 = {s ∈ …} and the struck '= (Σ ∩ M_0)'.
Φ_0 is used but never defined on this page. It is presumably Σ ∩ M_0, so that Φ_0 \ Φ_is is the set of non-isolated points of Σ.

ideas.what: Decomposing a constructible subset of a stratified interval into its maximal 1-strata, its isolated points, and the boundary points of its 1-strata; recovering a 'purified' polygon from a constructible set.
ideas.modern_name: Canonical stratification / normal form of constructible (semialgebraic or o-minimal) subsets of the line

ideas.what: Complements of constructible sets are constructible, and complementation corresponds to the complementary polygon in the set of strata of a découpage.
ideas.modern_name: Boolean algebra of constructible sets subordinate to a stratification
ideas.where_published: Constructible sets in EGA IV §1 (algebraic setting)

ideas.what: Découpages T ⊃ ∂I of the interval and polygons as subsets of the set of strata Φ_T; a duality Φ ↦ Φ* exchanging isolated and local boundary types, with cosupp = supp of the complement.
ideas.modern_name: Combinatorial model of open/closed (Verdier-type) duality on a stratified interval; support axioms

missed.claim: The page is a building block for an axiomatics of supports and cosupports ('axiome des supports Atsupp 1' on the next page), tested on the stratified interval with a duality Φ ↦ Φ*. The general axiom system, and its intended use within 'ateliers', is not developed here and does not seem to appear in the published record.
missed.quote: On appelle polygone subordonné au découpage T, toute partie Φ de cet ensemble Φ_T
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It could be compared with modern abstract support data, e.g. support theories for tensor-triangulated categories (Balmer) or recollement/stratification axiomatics. However, the content on this page itself is elementary.

deep.surprise_reason: This is elementary combinatorics of constructible subsets of a stratified interval. Its only interest is as a fragment of an unpublished support/duality axiomatics; nothing here would surprise a specialist.
transcription_corrections: The letter rendered 𝔏 throughout is Φ (as on the neighbouring pages): Φ_1, Φ_is, Φ_0, Φ_T, CΦ.
'Dr_p(I)' is more plausibly 'Dcp(I)', the set of découpages of I.
The interlinear insertion read '{+, avec quant[?]+}' is more likely 'convenant': 'et le passage au complément, convenant des côtés des polygones, …'.
The left-margin note '6 Φ^{kd}' is not δ𝔏^{kd}; its exact reading is uncertain.
'Φ_0 \ Φ_is' is correctly read as a set difference.
The bottom-left '20' is the archive page number.
